user_task: Check the GitHub Actions caching workflow configuration.
content:
name: Cached Build

on: [push]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Node Cache
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-
      - name: Install and Build
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
rationale: A standard GitHub Actions workflow snippet demonstrating standard dependency caching.

user_task: Check the Django application's serializers documentation for API design rules.

# DRF Serializer Standards

When implementing Django REST Framework serializers for API endpoints, developers must observe:

- Always define explicit fields using `serializers.ModelSerializer` rather than using `fields = '__all__'` in production code.
- Implement custom validation methods using `validate_<fieldname>` for complex business logic checks.
- Ensure read-only fields are properly marked to protect sensitive model attributes.
rationale: Standard API design documentation for Django REST Framework serializers.
